productInvocationFinding.basis: Exact archived _case_impl calls prepare_pair before direct launch facts/Popen. Exact prepare_pair throws in finish_prepared_clone before driver/spec/association creation. Both complete original archives lack those subsequent artifacts. Auxiliary version, ACL-setup, and host-only processes did execute.
productInvocationFinding.claimBoundary: Recorded composition path only; no new global process-observation requirement.

causeBoundary.observed: Both hosts have the same 14 security mismatches at clone preparation; all other strict non-clone-identity/non-directory-mtime fields agree. Direct snapshots remained unchanged during copying and rejected restoration; held snapshots also remained unchanged after rejection.
causeBoundary.order: Direct creates role children and sentinel before protect_parents; held creates only the required parent directories, protects them, then creates copied descendants. finish_prepared_clone refuses before any timestamp restoration or installer launch.
causeBoundary.hypothesis: The asymmetric creation/protection order gives original descendants broader retained ACL entries than the subsequently created held descendants. Current cloning does not reproduce those actual security strings.
causeBoundary.uncertainty: The originals lack per-descendant security snapshots immediately before/after the direct protection call, so the precise Windows transition for each ACE is an inference. No source-copy/ACL API behavioral claim is established beyond observed unequal results.

rootCorrectionPlanAssessment.proposed: Create only ROOT, case root, subject, subject/temp, and host-home; apply unchanged protection to those exact paths; then create local/roam/pf/pf86 and sentinel with unchanged paths/bytes before host-only baseline.
rootCorrectionPlanAssessment.assessment: Supported narrow correction hypothesis: all fourteen original security mismatches originate in the moved sentinel or those four subtree roots/descendants; already-protected role roots match. It preserves complete comparisons and does not normalize ACLs.
rootCorrectionPlanAssessment.staticDiscriminator: AST-prefix witness should show non-required role children and sentinel absent when protect_parents is called, required parents present, and original fourteen mismatched observations still strictly rejected.
rootCorrectionPlanAssessment.nativeDiscriminator: The next retained preparation pair must show every original ROW_FIELDS security value matching across mapped rows, with unchanged clone identity mapping and full directory-mtime restoration/comparison. Existing full prepared inventories provide this falsifiable discriminator before either installer leg. If any mismatch remains, do not suppress it or infer completion from static order alone.
